name: Clamshell
steps: Lie on your side with hips stacked, knees bent forward, and heels aligned with your spine.
Keep your heels together and rotate your top hip to lift your top knee upward.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your knee back down under control.
Turn onto your other side and repeat the movement.
tips: Stop lifting before your pelvis starts rolling backward.
Brace your core lightly so the motion stays isolated in your outer hip.
